evidence_provenance.optimization: Post-route placement/routing/rewire/critical-cell and actual TNS cleanup of R59 2-to-6 parallel FDRE topology. No new source/CSR/clock/serial-stage/timing-exception changes; original functional/synth reused R52, FF copy exact state/load evidence inherited R59. Before/after FF families and all94 DSP properties must be audited. Direct R59 and best R57 timing compared separately.

inherited_FF_copy_audit.port_normalization: Explicit ordered part-select bit expansion; e.g original DI concat {...,xlo[16:14]} versus {...,xlo[16],xlo[15]_repN,xlo[14]}. Initial raw string audit stopped on this one CARRY4 DI, never PASS; normalize vector presentation without omitting any bit or port, then compare all instances. Repetition expressions retained unchanged.
inherited_FF_copy_audit.scope: FDRE same INIT and D/C/CE/R imply equal copies by induction for known digital controls. Parsed instance parameters/ports equal after aliases; full exact load repartition verified. Not fullRoot SDF/formal, arbitrary analog reset/metastability/physical CDC/board proof. All original routes were released; routed timing is newly measured.

physical_register_audit.state_copy_math: FDRE q_next=R?0:(CE?D:q); FDSE q_next=S?1:(CE?D:q). Same primitive, INIT, clock, set/reset, CE and D imply equal copies by induction for known digital controls. New multiplier bit0 is FDSE/INIT1 because original CSR resets to1; its S input is preserved, not treated as FDRE/reset0. Multiple matching existing copies are canonicalized only after identical raw state signatures are verified.
physical_register_audit.initial_audit_stop: Initial FDRE-only allowed-list stopped on actual FDSE multiplier bit0 replica before PASS. Inspected original and new ref/INIT/S/D/CE/C, added explicit FDSE state-copy proof; no production/netlist edits or skipped port comparisons.
physical_register_audit.scope: Parsed mapped instance graph plus exact FDRE/FDSE state-copy induction and exhaustive known-binary changed LUT cuts. Rewire raw load differences if any are recorded, never claimed invariant. Not arbitrary X/Z equivalence, independent fullRoot formal/postmap/SDF simulation, physical CDC/metastability or board/plant proof. RTL native tests and synthesis inherited R52, not rerun.

vector_normalization_audit.method: Use actual per-module wire/input/output/inout declarations, assert shared ranges identical before/after, expand whole buses and part-selects in exact Verilog MSB-to-LSB concatenation order, then apply verified state aliases. Repetitions kept intact. No port excluded.
vector_normalization_audit.initial_stops: First vector comparison stopped at DSP48E1_48/B: {1b0,xlo0[16:0]} represented by a whole17-bit wire versus17 explicit bits because bit2 was replicated. Added declaration-aware expansion. First declaration regex expected a space after ], but Vivado writes wire [16:0]name; regex corrected to optional whitespace. Assertions still compare every bit and every parsed instance; original netlists/source unchanged.
